guides.title: Pramipexole
guides.description: A dopamine agonist with randomized evidence as an add-on for treatment-resistant unipolar depression.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Pramipexole is a dopamine agonist used for Parkinson’s disease and restless legs syndrome. PAX-D found improvement when it was added for treatment-resistant unipolar depression.

sentences.text: Pramipexole is a dopamine agonist used for Parkinson’s disease and restless legs syndrome.
PAX-D found improvement when it was added for treatment-resistant unipolar depression.

sections.label: Benefits
sections.paragraph: In PAX-D, depressive symptoms improved more with adjunctive pramipexole than placebo over 12 weeks, including anhedonia scores; tolerability remains part of the tradeoff.

sentences.text: In PAX-D, depressive symptoms improved more with adjunctive pramipexole than placebo over 12 weeks, including anhedonia scores; tolerability remains part of the tradeoff.

questions.question: How much did depression scores improve?
questions.answer: The adjusted between-group difference in self-rated depression change at 12 weeks was −3.91 QIDS-SR points (95% CI −5.37 to −2.45), favoring pramipexole.

sentences.text: The adjusted between-group difference in self-rated depression change at 12 weeks was −3.91 QIDS-SR points (95% CI −5.37 to −2.45), favoring pramipexole.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Important risks include sudden sleep episodes, hallucinations, low blood pressure on standing and new compulsive urges.

sentences.text: Important risks include sudden sleep episodes, hallucinations, low blood pressure on standing and new compulsive urges.

sections.label: Contraindications
sections.paragraph: The US tablet label lists no formal contraindications; renal impairment and psychiatric vulnerability still affect prescribing decisions.

sentences.text: The US tablet label lists no formal contraindications; renal impairment and psychiatric vulnerability still affect prescribing decisions.

sections.label: Interactions
sections.paragraph: Alcohol and sedating medicines increase drowsiness; dopamine antagonists may reduce its effect, and cimetidine can increase exposure.

sentences.text: Alcohol and sedating medicines increase drowsiness; dopamine antagonists may reduce its effect, and cimetidine can increase exposure.

sections.label: Dosing
sections.paragraph: PAX-D gradually increased adjunctive treatment toward a target of 2.5 mg daily; this was a depression trial regimen.

sentences.text: PAX-D gradually increased adjunctive treatment toward a target of 2.5 mg daily; this was a depression trial regimen.

sections.label: Results
sections.paragraph: At 12 weeks, remission occurred in 19 of 68 assessed participants receiving pramipexole and 5 of 67 receiving placebo.

sentences.text: At 12 weeks, remission occurred in 19 of 68 assessed participants receiving pramipexole and 5 of 67 receiving placebo.

sections.label: Quality
sections.paragraph: This profile refers to oral pramipexole; immediate-release tablets have indication-specific schedules and renal dose adjustments.

sentences.text: This profile refers to oral pramipexole; immediate-release tablets have indication-specific schedules and renal dose adjustments.

sections.label: Status
sections.paragraph: Depression is outside the US tablet indications, despite the positive randomized augmentation trial.

sentences.text: Depression is outside the US tablet indications, despite the positive randomized augmentation trial.

sentences.text: At 12 weeks, remission occurred in 19 of 68 assessed participants receiving pramipexole and 5 of 67 receiving placebo.

sentences.text: Research connections include Treatment-resistant depression.

faqs.answer: Pramipexole stimulates dopamine D2-family receptors, with preference for D3; it is used for Parkinson’s disease and restless legs syndrome.

guides.title: Guanfacine
guides.description: An alpha-2A agonist investigated with N-acetylcysteine for Long COVID cognitive symptoms.

sentences.text: Guanfacine extended release is an ADHD medicine.
Its Long COVID evidence includes a small uncontrolled series using combination treatment.

sections.label: Benefits

sentences.text: Eight of twelve patients reported improved cognitive symptoms with guanfacine and N-acetylcysteine; the series cannot separate the drugs’ effects from other changes.

sentences.text: Patients reported better working memory, concentration and executive function; four discontinued treatment, including two with hypotension or dizziness.

sentences.text: Immediate-release and extended-release guanfacine are not interchangeable milligram for milligram.

sentences.text: Long COVID is outside the extended-release product’s ADHD indication.

sentences.text: The report measured patients’ experience without randomization or a placebo comparison.

sentences.text: Research connections include Long COVID.

faqs.answer: Guanfacine stimulates central alpha-2A adrenergic receptors; the extended-release product is used for ADHD and can lower heart rate and blood pressure.

guides.title: Maraviroc
guides.description: An HIV-entry inhibitor investigated for tumor-cell migration and the immune environment around cancers.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Maraviroc is used with other antiretroviral medicines for CCR5-tropic HIV-1 infection. Cancer studies investigate whether the same receptor can alter invasion or the local immune response.

sentences.text: Maraviroc is used with other antiretroviral medicines for CCR5-tropic HIV-1 infection.
Cancer studies investigate whether the same receptor can alter invasion or the local immune response.

sections.label: Benefits
sections.paragraph: Breast and pancreatic findings cited here concern preclinical invasion or spread. The colorectal program included a small early clinical study, which gives exploratory evidence rather than a comparative survival result.

sentences.text: Breast and pancreatic findings cited here concern preclinical invasion or spread.
The colorectal program included a small early clinical study, which gives exploratory evidence rather than a comparative survival result.

questions.question: Has it prevented breast-cancer spread in patients?
questions.answer: The cited work reduced pulmonary metastasis in mice; it did not test prevention of metastasis in patients.

sentences.text: The cited work reduced pulmonary metastasis in mice; it did not test prevention of metastasis in patients.

questions.question: What did the colorectal program demonstrate?
questions.answer: It linked CCR5 blockade to macrophage changes and tumor-cell death, with clinical activity in an early pilot; a randomized survival advantage was not tested.

sentences.text: It linked CCR5 blockade to macrophage changes and tumor-cell death, with clinical activity in an early pilot; a randomized survival advantage was not tested.

questions.question: What is known in pancreatic cancer?
questions.answer: Maraviroc reduced CCL5-driven invasive behavior in cell experiments; that study did not measure patient outcomes.

sentences.text: Maraviroc reduced CCL5-driven invasive behavior in cell experiments; that study did not measure patient outcomes.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Maraviroc carries a hepatotoxicity warning, sometimes preceded by allergic features; postural hypotension and severe skin reactions are also concerns.

sentences.text: Maraviroc carries a hepatotoxicity warning, sometimes preceded by allergic features; postural hypotension and severe skin reactions are also concerns.

sections.label: Contraindications

sentences.text: Severe renal impairment or end-stage renal disease together with potent CYP3A inhibitors or inducers is a contraindication.

sections.label: Interactions
sections.paragraph: Potent CYP3A inhibitors and inducers substantially alter maraviroc exposure and determine its labeled dosing.

sentences.text: Potent CYP3A inhibitors and inducers substantially alter maraviroc exposure and determine its labeled dosing.

sections.label: Dosing
sections.paragraph: The HIV regimen depends on accompanying medicines and kidney function; it is not a validated cancer regimen.

sentences.text: The HIV regimen depends on accompanying medicines and kidney function; it is not a validated cancer regimen.

sections.label: Results

sentences.text: The cancer rationale concerns host CCR5 signaling, not treatment of an HIV infection inside the tumor.

sections.label: Quality

sentences.text: The labeled products include film-coated tablets and an oral solution.

sections.label: Status

sentences.text: Its US indication is CCR5-tropic HIV-1 infection; cancer uses remain investigational.

sentences.text: Research connections include Breast cancer, Colorectal cancer and Pancreatic cancer.

faqs.answer: Maraviroc blocks the human CCR5 receptor, preventing CCR5-tropic HIV-1 from entering susceptible cells.

guides.title: Rituximab
guides.description: A B-cell-depleting antibody explored in a very small vitiligo pilot.

sections.paragraph: Rituximab is used in specified B-cell cancers and autoimmune diseases. Its vitiligo evidence includes an uncontrolled five-person pilot.

sentences.text: Rituximab is used in specified B-cell cancers and autoimmune diseases.
Its vitiligo evidence includes an uncontrolled five-person pilot.

sentences.text: Three of five participants showed substantial clinical and histological improvement after treatment; the tiny uncontrolled study cannot establish an average treatment effect.

guides.title: Memantine
guides.description: An NMDA-receptor blocker investigated for temozolomide resistance in glioblastoma cells.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Memantine’s glioblastoma investigation concerns NMDA signaling and temozolomide resistance.

sentences.text: Memantine’s glioblastoma investigation concerns NMDA signaling and temozolomide resistance.

sections.label: Benefits
sections.paragraph: Cell experiments connect NMDA blockade with temozolomide sensitivity; they provide no patient survival estimate.

sentences.text: Cell experiments connect NMDA blockade with temozolomide sensitivity; they provide no patient survival estimate.

questions.question: What benefit did the laboratory study investigate?
questions.answer: The study examined whether interrupting NMDA signaling could counter MGMT-associated temozolomide resistance.

sentences.text: The study examined whether interrupting NMDA signaling could counter MGMT-associated temozolomide resistance.

questions.question: Was this a glioblastoma patient trial?
questions.answer: No. Its treatment-response experiments used glioblastoma cells.

sentences.text: No. Its treatment-response experiments used glioblastoma cells.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Common adverse effects include dizziness, headache, confusion, and constipation. Reduced kidney function can increase exposure.

sentences.text: Common adverse effects include dizziness, headache, confusion, and constipation. Reduced kidney function can increase exposure.

sections.label: Contraindications
sections.paragraph: Hypersensitivity to memantine or a formulation ingredient is a contraindication.

sentences.text: Hypersensitivity to memantine or a formulation ingredient is a contraindication.

sections.label: Interactions
sections.paragraph: Alkaline urine can reduce clearance. Combining other NMDA antagonists, including amantadine, ketamine, or dextromethorphan, requires caution.

sentences.text: Alkaline urine can reduce clearance. Combining other NMDA antagonists, including amantadine, ketamine, or dextromethorphan, requires caution.

sections.label: Dosing
sections.paragraph: The glioblastoma study tested cell concentrations and temozolomide combinations, not a patient schedule.

sentences.text: The glioblastoma study tested cell concentrations and temozolomide combinations, not a patient schedule.

sections.label: Results
sections.paragraph: NMDA signaling increased MGMT expression and resistance in the studied cells.

sentences.text: NMDA signaling increased MGMT expression and resistance in the studied cells.

sections.label: Quality
sections.paragraph: The cited oral solution contains 2 mg/mL. Liquid concentration and tablet strength describe different dosage forms and require consistent units.

sentences.text: The cited oral solution contains 2 mg/mL. Liquid concentration and tablet strength describe different dosage forms and require consistent units.

sections.label: Status
sections.paragraph: US labeling concerns moderate-to-severe Alzheimer dementia. Glioblastoma is an investigational use.

sentences.text: US labeling concerns moderate-to-severe Alzheimer dementia. Glioblastoma is an investigational use.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: MGMT biology and the cell model delimit this mechanistic evidence.

sentences.text: MGMT biology and the cell model delimit this mechanistic evidence.

sections.label: Connections
sections.paragraph: The glioblastoma investigation links glutamate signaling with DNA repair during temozolomide treatment; it differs from memantine’s symptomatic neurological indication.

sentences.text: The glioblastoma investigation links glutamate signaling with DNA repair during temozolomide treatment; it differs from memantine’s symptomatic neurological indication.

sections.label: Research
sections.paragraph: Translation requires determining whether NMDA blockade changes temozolomide response in patients.

sentences.text: Translation requires determining whether NMDA blockade changes temozolomide response in patients.

faqs.question: Does memantine’s Alzheimer indication imply it slows tumor growth?
faqs.answer: No. Symptomatic neurological efficacy and tumor-cell chemotherapy sensitivity are different outcomes.

guides.scope: An NMDA-receptor blocker investigated for temozolomide resistance in glioblastoma cells.

guides.title: Vorinostat
guides.description: An HDAC inhibitor nominated for anti-TNF-refractory Crohn’s disease through gene-expression analysis.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Vorinostat is a cancer medicine with an epigenetic mechanism. Its Crohn’s connection arises from an analysis of anti-TNF-refractory disease transcriptomes.

sentences.text: Vorinostat is a cancer medicine with an epigenetic mechanism. Its Crohn’s connection arises from an analysis of anti-TNF-refractory disease transcriptomes.

sections.label: Benefits
sections.paragraph: The Crohn’s study provides a biological candidate, not a measured improvement in symptoms or remission. Vorinostat’s relevance came from its relationship to inflammatory gene-expression patterns.

sentences.text: The Crohn’s study provides a biological candidate, not a measured improvement in symptoms or remission. Vorinostat’s relevance came from its relationship to inflammatory gene-expression patterns.

questions.question: What did the Crohn’s analysis actually find?
questions.answer: Vorinostat was a nominated compound in cluster 1, with a CMap enrichment score of 12.3.

sentences.text: Vorinostat was a nominated compound in cluster 1, with a CMap enrichment score of 12.3.

questions.question: Is that score a probability of remission?
questions.answer: No. It is a computational enrichment score describing a relationship between gene and drug signatures.

sentences.text: No. It is a computational enrichment score describing a relationship between gene and drug signatures.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Important risks include thrombocytopenia, anemia, diarrhea and dehydration, hyperglycemia, and venous thromboembolism.

sentences.text: Important risks include thrombocytopenia, anemia, diarrhea and dehydration, hyperglycemia, and venous thromboembolism.

sections.label: Contraindications
sections.paragraph: The US label lists no formal contraindications; exposure during pregnancy can harm the fetus, and hepatic impairment affects dosing.

sentences.text: The US label lists no formal contraindications; exposure during pregnancy can harm the fetus, and hepatic impairment affects dosing.

sections.label: Interactions
sections.paragraph: Warfarin can show increased INR. Other HDAC inhibitors, including valproic acid, have been associated with severe thrombocytopenia and gastrointestinal bleeding.

sentences.text: Warfarin can show increased INR. Other HDAC inhibitors, including valproic acid, have been associated with severe thrombocytopenia and gastrointestinal bleeding.

sections.label: Dosing
sections.paragraph: The Crohn’s transcriptome analysis administered no vorinostat regimen. Its compound ranking contains no patient dose–response comparison.

sentences.text: The Crohn’s transcriptome analysis administered no vorinostat regimen. Its compound ranking contains no patient dose–response comparison.

sections.label: Results
sections.paragraph: The reported result is a cluster-specific molecular association, generated from a single transcriptome dataset rather than a vorinostat-treated cohort.

sentences.text: The reported result is a cluster-specific molecular association, generated from a single transcriptome dataset rather than a vorinostat-treated cohort.

sections.label: Quality

sentences.text: Zolinza is an oral 100 mg capsule product; capsules should not be opened or crushed.

sentences.text: US labeling covers cutaneous manifestations of persistent, progressive, or recurrent cutaneous T-cell lymphoma after two systemic therapies. Crohn’s disease is a separate investigational setting.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: The anti-TNF-refractory Crohn’s analysis used GSE100833 and pathway/compound matching. Reliance on one dataset limits how broadly the identified molecular pattern represents patients.

sentences.text: The anti-TNF-refractory Crohn’s analysis used GSE100833 and pathway/compound matching. Reliance on one dataset limits how broadly the identified molecular pattern represents patients.

sections.label: Connections
sections.paragraph: Vorinostat and clomipramine were nominated from different gene clusters in the same Crohn’s analysis. Their established targets and risks are different.

sentences.text: Vorinostat and clomipramine were nominated from different gene clusters in the same Crohn’s analysis. Their established targets and risks are different.

sections.label: Research
sections.paragraph: The biological question is whether HDAC modulation produces useful intestinal anti-inflammatory effects at a tolerable exposure.

sentences.text: The biological question is whether HDAC modulation produces useful intestinal anti-inflammatory effects at a tolerable exposure.

faqs.question: Does the Crohn’s study mean vorinostat failed anti-TNF treatment?
faqs.answer: No. Anti-TNF-refractory describes the patients whose gene-expression data were analyzed, not prior vorinostat treatment.

sentences.text: No. Anti-TNF-refractory describes the patients whose gene-expression data were analyzed, not prior vorinostat treatment.

guides.scope: An HDAC inhibitor nominated for anti-TNF-refractory Crohn’s disease through gene-expression analysis.

guides.title: Clomipramine
guides.description: A serotonin-reuptake inhibitor appearing as a computational Crohn’s candidate, without a treated Crohn’s cohort in that study.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Clomipramine is established for obsessive-compulsive disorder. A Crohn’s gene-expression study identified it as a separate repurposing candidate.

sentences.text: Clomipramine is established for obsessive-compulsive disorder. A Crohn’s gene-expression study identified it as a separate repurposing candidate.

sections.label: Benefits

sentences.text: The cited Crohn’s analysis did not treat patients with clomipramine or measure remission. Its result is a candidate association derived from gene-expression patterns.

sentences.text: Clomipramine appeared in cluster 2 with a CMap enrichment score of 8.4.

questions.question: What patient improvement was measured?

sentences.text: Risks include seizures, serotonin syndrome, cardiac-conduction effects, anticholinergic symptoms, and increased suicidal thoughts or behavior in younger patients.

sections.label: Contraindications

sentences.text: Concurrent or recent MAO inhibitors and the acute recovery period after myocardial infarction are contraindications.

sentences.text: The central question is what intestinal or immune action, if any, accounts for the gene-signature association.

guides.scope: A serotonin-reuptake inhibitor appearing as a computational Crohn’s candidate, without a treated Crohn’s cohort in that study.

guides.title: Fluconazole

guides.scope: Antifungal uses, ergosterol synthesis, resistance and the distinction between infection treatment and proposed new uses.

Pregnancy, heart rhythm problems, kidney disease and liver disease affect its safe use.

sections.label: Contraindications
sections.paragraph: Known fluconazole hypersensitivity is a contraindication; certain QT-prolonging combinations, including pimozide and quinidine, are also contraindicated.

sentences.text: Known fluconazole hypersensitivity is a contraindication; certain QT-prolonging combinations, including pimozide and quinidine, are also contraindicated.

sections.label: Interactions
sections.paragraph: Fluconazole inhibits CYP2C9, CYP2C19 and CYP3A4, potentially increasing exposure to other medicines. Prescription medicines, over-the-counter products and supplements should be checked together for interactions.

sentences.text: Fluconazole inhibits CYP2C9, CYP2C19 and CYP3A4, potentially increasing exposure to other medicines.

sections.label: Dosing
sections.paragraph: Treatment duration ranges from a single dose to weeks or longer, depending on the infection and response; tablets and oral suspension are available. Shake oral suspension well before each use; unused liquid is discarded after 14 days according to the patient information. A regimen for one infection should not be assumed appropriate for another indication.

sections.label: Results
sections.paragraph: For vaginal candidiasis, clinical improvement and negative fungal cultures are distinct outcomes. CDC reports that azole treatment achieves both in most patients who complete treatment for uncomplicated disease. Those infection outcomes do not measure biofilm destruction or benefit in a non-fungal condition.
